# Commit ids before and after the 20 Oct 2026 history purge

On 20 Oct 2026, hv had the AI-attribution trailers (`Co-Authored-By: Claude ...`, `Claude-Session: ...`) purged from the history of Molt and Molt-matts. Only the messages of the commits that carried them changed. Every commit kept its tree, author, committer and dates, but each commit from the first trailer onward has a new id. Molt's 84 commits before 4 Sep 2026, and its tags `v0.1.0` and `v0.1.1`, kept theirs.

Anything that cites an old id (a whiteboard item, an issue, an older note, another repo's message) can be translated here. `done.md`, `wip.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` were translated when the purge was folded. Only the commits whose id changed are listed.
